name: Cognia Plugin Template TS
description: Frontend TypeScript plugin template — a tool, a slash command, a quick action, a UI slot, a workflow node and trigger, and its own settings. Replace this manifest with your own plugin's metadata.

permissionJustifications.extension:ui: Mounts the template panel into the chat composer's action row.
permissionJustifications.theme:read: Reads the user's motion preference before animating the panel.
permissionJustifications.settings:read: Reads this plugin's own greeting prefix and echo-uppercase settings.
permissionJustifications.extension:workflow: Contributes the template workflow node and trigger to the visual workflow editor.

commands.name: Template Greet
commands.description: Print a greeting back to the chat. Replace with your own command.

quickActions.title: Template Greet
quickActions.description: Run the template's greeting command from the palette, composer or tray.

tools.name: template_echo
tools.description: Echo the supplied message back to the agent. Replace with your own tool.

nodes.label: Template Echo
nodes.description: Echo its input downstream. Replace with your own node.

triggers.label: Template Ticker
triggers.description: Emit one event every N seconds. Replace with your own trigger source.
